name: stats-trend-cards
title: Stats Trend Cards
description: Left-aligned metric cards with a corner icon, a counting number and a green or red change chip.

props.name: title
props.description: Section headline. Labels the section for assistive tech.

props.name: stats
props.description: Two to four stats: value, prefix, suffix, decimalPlaces, label, icon and trend.

props.name: trendNote
props.description: Text after each trend chip, e.g. "vs last month".

props.name: disabled
props.description: Turns the entrance animation and the count-up off.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root element.
